item.title: 2 trapped Nepal hydropower tunnel workers rescued 9 days after floods
item.description: Rescuers in Nepal pulled two workers alive from a hydropower tunnel as emergency teams continued efforts to reach others believed to be trapped and still alive inside, officials said.

item.title: Vance "extremely skeptical" U.S. strike hit Iran wedding party
item.description: Iran responded to a warning from President Trump with claims of new strikes against U.S. forces in Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.

item.title: Trump commutes former Philadelphia labor leader "Johnny Doc's" prison sentence
item.description: President Trump agreed to commute the rest of former Philadelphia labor leader Johnny Doc's prison sentence, his lawyer says.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy jury leaves without verdict, defense wants juror dismissed
item.description: A sixth day of jury deliberations in Lindsay Clancy's Massachusetts murder trial ended Thursday without a verdict.

item.title: Work on Trump-backed Triumphal Arch will start in coming weeks
item.description: The federal government plans to start excavation over the next two weeks on a massive triumphal arch near Washington, D.C., Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum said, a controversial project championed by President Trump.

item.title: Trump names new acting Army secretary after Driscoll resigns
item.description: President Trump has named Adam Telle as the acting Army secretary, following the departure of Dan Driscoll amid widespread reports of tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Reactions pour in for Gloria Steinem: "Her words, her spirit will live on"
item.description: Gloria Steinem, a feminist icon and a trailblazer for women's rights, has died at 92. Activist and #MeToo movement founder Tarana Burke, women's rights attorney Gloria Allred and others spoke with CBS News about her impact.

item.title: ICE officer who shot immigrant in Minnesota in federal custody, source says
item.description: Federal prosecutors have charged an ICE officer who shot a Venezuelan immigrant in Minnesota with making false statements about the incident, sources said. He is now in custody.

item.title: Missouri's top court blocks new House map favoring GOP until voters can weigh in
item.description: The Missouri Supreme Court has blocked a new House map backed by President Trump from being used in the November election, a setback in Republicans' efforts to pick up an additional House seat.

item.title: Federal prosecutor fired after investigating ICE officer for civil rights offenses
item.description: A federal prosecutor in Minnesota who was investigating an ICE officer for possible civil rights crimes has been fired, four sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

item.title: Going under ground zero, where a dangerous cleanup was underway | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: Large chunks of debris crashed through underground basements during the 9/11 attacks. 60 Minutes visited several months afterwards, when an exhausting and dangerous cleanup effort was underway.

item.title: DOJ asks Supreme Court to allow Postal Service rules on mail ballots
item.description: The Justice Department asked the Supreme Court to intervene in an ongoing legal battle over U.S. Postal Service rules for mail ballots just weeks before the November midterm elections.

item.title: Gloria Allred speaks out on Lindsay Clancy trial
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy murder trial has sparked complicated conversations around motherhood, postpartum and mental health. Women's rights attorney Gloria Allred joins CBS News to discuss the case.

item.title: Gloria Allred honors Gloria Steinem after her death: "Her words, her spirit will live on"
item.description: Gloria Steinem, a journalist and trailblazer of the women's liberation movement, has died at 92, her foundation announced Thursday. Women's rights attorney Gloria Allred joins CBS News to discuss Steinem's impact on the world.

item.title: World Cup of Tiramisu competition seeks judges
item.description: Tiramisu is one of the most popular desserts in the world, and in Italy, the 10th annual World Cup of Tiramisu is a real competition seeking judges. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Gloria Steinem, trailblazing figure in women's liberation movement, dies at 92
item.description: Gloria Steinem, co-founder of Ms. Magazine, was a leader in raising awareness about gender equality and violence against women, and for promoting inclusion, representation and social justice for women and girls.

item.title: FBI using AI to zero in on threats faster, deputy director says
item.description: FBI Deputy Director Christopher Raia says the bureau is turning to artificial intelligence as a tool to identify threats and act on them faster.

item.title: Millions of travelers to face high gas prices over Labor Day weekend
item.description: Labor Day travelers are set to face gas prices over $4 a gallon this year. Clint Henderson, managing editor of The Points Guys, shares his best tips for planning an affordable trip.

item.title: Suspect in downtown Minneapolis mass shooting was facing eviction
item.description: The man suspected of killing two people and injuring six others in a mass shooting at a downtown Minneapolis apartment complex Wednesday was facing eviction after a string of incidents including assault and allegedly showing a gun to apartment management, according to court documents.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell to return to "CBS Mornings"
item.description: Norah O'Donnell will be joining Gayle King and Nate Burleson as co-host of "CBS Mornings" starting Tuesday, Sept. 8. It will be a homecoming for O'Donnell, who co-hosted the broadcast from 2012 to 2019.

item.title: SEC legal battle with LSU could reshape college football and governance of all college sports
item.description: Just days before the first week of the college football season, a judge is set to rule on whether former professional football players can return to campus and play football. Mark Strassmann has the details.

item.title: Iowa GOP gubernatorial nominee Zach Lahn credits victory over Trump ally to "being on the ground"
item.description: Democrats have not occupied the governor's mansion in Iowa since 2011, but a new Emerson poll reveals that the race is in a dead heat. Republican gubernatorial nominee Zach Lahn joins "The Takeout" to discuss his campaign.

item.title: 9/3: CBS Evening News
item.description: Lindsay Clancy jury deadlocked on Day 6; Woman shot man over parking spot in June.

item.title: Rep. James Walkinshaw on what USPS whistleblower told House committee about new mail voting system
item.description: A whistleblower at the U.S. Postal Service is warning that a new mail-in voting system could create major problems and prevent millions of Americans from receiving their ballots. Democratic Rep. James Walkinshaw of Virginia, who sits on the House committee the whistleblower contacted, joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: American automakers urge Congress to ban Chinese vehicle sales in U.S.
item.description: Chinese cars can collect and send consumer and vehicle data to Beijing, U.S. automaker group warns in calling for a ban on sales.

item.title: Gas prices surge just before Labor Day, as diesel nears record high
item.description: "Diesel is just a couple of ticks away from hitting a new record," one energy expert said. "That will happen."

item.title: Election officials raise alarm over mail voting rules: "Virtually impossible"
item.description: One official in California said that scanning individual ballots for every voter in the state would take roughly 43 years based on the Postal Service's estimates.

item.title: Postal Service mail voting rules face extended block as judge presses DOJ
item.description: A federal judge is considering whether to continue blocking a U.S. Postal Service rule imposing new requirements for mail voting.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell returning as co-host of "CBS Mornings"
item.description: Norah O'Donnell​ is returning as co-host of "CBS Mornings" alongside Gayle King and Nate Burleson.

item.title: Man unknowingly buys former plantation house where his ancestors were enslaved
item.description: An Air Force veteran wanted a new house for large family gatherings; he ended up getting an incredible link to his family's past.
